t: This is the monument to John Jay, a sarcophagus in Abney Park Cemetery in Hackney. Jay lived from 1805 to 1872. He began as a skilled stonemason and went on to own a building firm in the City of London, working in the middle of the nineteenth century, when the city and its railways were growing fast. His firm built the Victorian clock tower and city clock of the Houses of Parliament. He also built smaller works, including Abney Park Chapel, the chapel in this cemetery, and the Trinity Independent Chapel.
